messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: multiple OOMs observed on kvcache-hostpool-3 (3/16 GPU nodes). service=runtime/gpu-serving severity=sev2. immediate container restarts + CUDA errors. thread_ts=6512349876

maria (oncall): seeing elevated 5xxs and latency from clients, routing started to fallback model-v0.8 :warning:

devon (eng-runtime): looking at logs now. initial pattern looks like slow KV-cache resident growth -> paged allocator fragmentation -> gradual OOM. stack traces show `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` then oom kill. snippet:```[2026-03-16T21:12:03Z] runtime: gpu0 alloc 1.2GB failed: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-03-16T21:12:05Z] container: restart invoked, reason=oom
```

leo (eng-sre): on it — cordoning affected nodes now to prevent new tasks. commands:```kubectl cordon kvcache-node-12 && kubectl drain kvcache-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data```

maria (oncall): @devon can we trigger emergency compaction/evict to reclaim KV pages without full restart?

devon (eng-runtime): yes. hitting the admin endpoint to force compact + shrink slabs:```curl -XPOST https://runtime-admin.internal/compaction?pool=kvcache&mode=aggressive -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"``` that will trigger in-process compaction. also toggling kv_eviction_policy=aggressive.

ops-bot: ACTION: compaction job queued (job id=cmp-651234). ETA ~45s.

samir (cust-ops): customer impact: monitoring shows ~0.8% of inference requests 503/504 across hosted-api for the last 8m, top affected tenants: tenant-phi, tenant-analytics. Ops page opened: https://internal.incidents/6512349876

leo (eng-sre): running quick check on driver/UCX versions — two nodes show mismatched cuda driver after last infra patch. posting nodes list: kvcache-node-12, kvcache-node-15, kvcache-node-22. if compaction doesn't reclaim enough, we'll evict pods and recycle those VMs.

devon (eng-runtime): temporary mitigation: reduce model shard residency and force smaller KV cache size on hot pool:```export REDWOOD_KV_MAX_RESIDENT=0.55 && rollout restart deployment/gpu-runtime-hotpool``` also enabling fallback routing in router: route 15% traffic to model-quantized-8bit.

maria (oncall): done—routing adjusted, telemetry shows latency stabilize for non-impacted tenants. still seeing intermittent restarts on node-12.

devon (eng-runtime): compaction completed, reclaimed ~6.2GB on node-15, node-12 still leaking. collecting heap/profile:```gcore -o /tmp/core.runtime $(pgrep runtime) && scp /tmp/core.runtime ops@artifact-store:/artifacts/651234-core```. filing ticket ENG-RT-1089 with profiles.

leo (eng-sre): initiating rolling recycle for node-12 and node-22 to clear driver mismatch + reclaim kernel resources. cordoned and scheduled reboot windows now.

samir (cust-ops): customer comms: sent preliminary notice to tenant-phi and tenant-analytics about degraded performance and mitigation steps. escalation to account teams if SLAs breached.

maria (oncall): escalation: escalating to eng-runtime on-call lead for postmortem if root cause is allocator fragmentation. @devon please own incident follow-up.

devon (eng-runtime): will take. initial hypothesis: paged-attention allocator fragmentation + slow KV-page leak interacts badly with recent paging threshold change (kv_page_warmup=ON by default). Reproducing locally with stress-suite.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: rollback attempted for runtime image sha:sha-0a1b2c -> previous sha-ff7788. rollback kicked off (id=deploy-651234-rollback).

maria (oncall): last update: customer errors down to 0.12% after routing + compaction, two nodes rebooting. marking handoff for morning follow-up and postmortem. leaving notes in incident doc: https://internal.incidents/6512349876/postmortem — handing to @devon and @leo. :white_check_mark:
